name: Rewait
source:
<Crossover of Two Stories>
The season is autumn. With the coming of winter, the last lingering leaves fall to the ground.
A girl, met by chance, bearing a cruel fate. No place to live, nothing to eat—all that remains is a small promise.
If she keeps believing in a promise that was betrayed... if she can keep believing.
──Simply, endlessly waiting──
Rewait
translation:
<两个故事的交叉>
季节是秋天。随着冬天的到来，最后几片残叶纷纷落下。
一个偶然遇见的女孩，背负着残酷的命运。没有地方住，没有东西吃——剩下的只是一个小小的承诺。
如果她继续相信一个被背叛的承诺……如果她能继续相信。
──只是无尽的等待──
重新等待
